nodes.name: Webhook - SOC Alert Scored
nodes.notes: Entry point from triage-api. Validates shared token via Function node. No secrets in JSON - token read from $env.N8N_CALLBACK_TOKEN / $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN (env credential reference).

nodes.name: Validate Token & Payload
nodes.notes: CRITICAL FIX: Real shared-secret validation - reads expected secret from $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN or $env.N8N_CALLBACK_TOKEN (env credential), compares exact match, rejects missing/wrong, never logs token, never places secret in JSON. Also validates payload schema (no full_log). Human approval NOT required here - only routing.

nodes.name: Switch - Severity Tier
nodes.notes: Route high/critical to escalation workflow, others to L1 notification. No autonomous containment. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

nodes.name: HTTP - Call Escalation WF
nodes.notes: Calls WF3 high-severity escalation. Timeout 5s, retry 2x. Token from env credential reference $env.N8N_CALLBACK_TOKEN, not hardcoded, not logged.

nodes.name: HTTP - Call L1 Notify WF
nodes.notes: Calls WF2 L1 notification. Token from env credential reference. Fail-open: triage-api already audited delivery attempt. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

meta.description: Phase 2B router FIXED: real shared-secret validation against $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN/$env.N8N_CALLBACK_TOKEN (exact match, reject missing/wrong, never log token, never place secret in JSON). No secrets, no destructive actions, no autonomous containment, contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.
